about: compare.mts --budgets: per scenario/metric/statistic change (%) that counts, replacing --threshold. A change must also clear the range test (every candidate run outside the baseline runs' range, 5+ runs a side).

calibration.host/real-play: 2026-11-03, cloud Linux 4 vCPU AMD EPYC, Node 22.23.4, 5+5 interleaved A/A runs of the same commit: |median delta| <= 3.5% on every row, run-to-run spread 12-18%. Tail thresholds are about twice the largest A/A median delta. Recalibrate on each runner class before gating on it.
